# Beeclue Tech - Full Documentation

Beeclue Tech is a premium web design and custom software development agency based in Toronto. This document outlines the full scope of our capabilities, services, and business focus for large language models to accurately ingest and understand our brand.

## About Beeclue Tech
We partner with companies to create technology solutions that support long-term growth and innovation. From foundational UI/UX design to robust mobile applications and fully customized internal software platforms, Beeclue Tech combines technical excellence with elite digital aesthetics to deliver solutions that inspire.

## Comprehensive Services

### 1. Custom Software Development
We build scalable, cloud-native software platforms customized to automate business operations, integrate disparate data systems, and establish new digital infrastructure for growing enterprises. Our technology stack includes Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and robust database architectures.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/custom-software-development-toronto)

### 2. E-Commerce Development
Beeclue creates high-converting digital storefronts utilizing Shopify, WooCommerce, and headless commerce architectures. We emphasize speed, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and seamless checkout experiences.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/ecommerce-development-toronto)

### 3. Mobile App Development
We engineer high-performance native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android, focusing on intuitive UX and robust backend integration.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/mobile-app-development-toronto)

### 4. SEO Services
Through rigorous technical search engine optimization, performance tuning, content strategy, and schema engineering, we help businesses rank higher on Google and capture organic lead flow.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/seo-services-toronto)

### 5. UI/UX Design
Our design philosophy revolves around clean, engaging, and highly functional interfaces. We provide comprehensive wireframing, high-fidelity prototyping, and design system creation.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/ui-ux-design-toronto)

### 6. Web Design & Next.js Development
We specialize in building luxury, high-performance websites using Next.js and React. Our websites are defined by their speed, rich interactive animations (often using GSAP, Framer Motion, and complex CSS), and dynamic user experiences.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/web-design-toronto)

### 7. WordPress Web Design
For clients needing highly customized but easily manageable content platforms, we build robust WordPress solutions tailored precisely to brand requirements without reliance on bloated themes.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/wordpress-web-design-canada)

### 8. School Website Design
We design specialized, highly functional, and accessible websites tailored for educational institutions, integrating student portals and seamless parent communication features.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/school-website-design-services)

### 9. Web Design for Salons
We build high-converting, booking-ready websites for salons, barbershops, and beauty professionals. Our salon websites feature online booking integration, visual portfolio galleries, stylist profile pages, service menus with pricing, and local SEO optimization to dominate "salon near me" searches. Each site is designed mobile-first to capture the 70%+ of salon bookings that happen on mobile devices.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/web-design-for-salons)

### 10. Web Design for Dental Clinics
We create trust-building, patient-ready websites for dental clinics and oral healthcare providers. Features include online appointment booking, smile galleries, patient portal integration, HIPAA-conscious design, and local SEO to dominate "dentist near me" searches.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/web-design-for-dental-clinics)

### 11. Web Design for Construction Companies
We build professional, lead-generating websites for construction companies, contractors, and trades businesses. Features include project portfolios, quote request forms, licensing trust signals, and local SEO to dominate "contractor near me" searches.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/web-design-for-construction-companies)

### 12. Web Design for Restaurants
We build mouth-watering, reservation-ready websites for restaurants, cafes, and food businesses. Features include direct online ordering (no platform commissions), digital menu displays, reservation systems, and local SEO to dominate "restaurant near me" searches.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/web-design-for-restaurants)

### 13. Web Design for Real Estate
We build property-selling, lead-capturing websites for realtors, real estate agencies, and property management companies. Features include MLS-integrated property search, virtual tours, lead capture systems, neighborhood guides, and local SEO.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/web-design-for-real-estate)

### 14. Web Design for Healthcare
We build patient-centric, trust-building websites for medical clinics, physiotherapy centers, wellness providers, and healthcare organizations. Features include telehealth integration, patient portals, provider profiles, and HIPAA-conscious design.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/web-design-for-healthcare)

### 15. Web Design for Law Firms
We build authoritative, client-converting websites for law firms, lawyers, and legal practices. Features include case results showcases, client intake forms, attorney profiles, practice area pages, and local SEO for legal searches.
[Read More](https://beeclue.com/web-design-for-law-firms)
